primary: Complete physical placement success for every planned full episode. Grasp detections, test lifts, abstentions and retries are separate diagnostics and never successes.
freeze: Register source/settings before any v10 full episode. No tuning within a cohort. Retain failures and all technical attempts. Fresh smoke runs after development, with no parameter changes. Fresh scenes are two seeds crossed with two conditions, not four independent scenes or a final test.
boundary: Only detached Obs learned capsule positions/timestamps and measured EE pose, joint positions and finger width enter RetentionFSM. No contact/force, actual object pose, evaluator feedback or simulator reference. Existing camera models, geometry, actuator/friction settings, original grasp geometry and placement/reacquisition logic unchanged.
scope: Opt-in control development. No v8 planner integration, no deeper grasp claim, no novelty or real-time guarantee. The fixture perturbation remains active throughout complete episodes. Visibility timeout holds closed and aborts; empty-hand/detached evidence can retract and invoke bounded visual reacquisition. Unknown visibility never counts as retained.
